summary: Fixes a class of white-page crashes across SupplierPage, PaymentTermsPage, and CategoryPage caused by a single root-cause bug: the /cube/by-supplier endpoint returns a paginated envelope {data: SupplierRow[], total_count: N} but every page does .then(r => r.data) and treats the envelope object as a plain array — calling .filter()/.sort() on a plain object throws TypeError and crashes the page with no error boundary to catch it. The sprint also adds a global ErrorBoundary to prevent future white screens, sets TanStack Query staleTime:5min on all dashboard queries to eliminate redundant refetches and make navigation feel instant, fixes the CategoryPage L2 drill-down null crash with an explicit Back button, adds backend endpoints for ingestion batch audit, and builds a new Ingestion Audit page so clients can verify their uploaded data was ingested and categorised correctly.

decisions.fix_by_supplier_extraction: Change .then(r => r.data) to .then(r => r.data?.data ?? []) in SupplierPage, PaymentTermsPage, and CategoryPage wherever /cube/by-supplier is called. The paginated envelope shape {data:[], total_count:N} is correct for the endpoint; the bug is in the consumers.
decisions.error_boundary_class_component: React ErrorBoundary must be a class component (getDerivedStateFromError/componentDidCatch are class-only lifecycle methods). Create a single reusable ErrorBoundary in frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx and wrap each route element in App.tsx individually.
decisions.stale_time_5min: Set staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000 on all dashboard data queries. Dashboard data changes only when a new file is uploaded — 5-minute client-side cache eliminates re-fetches on every tab switch. Layout sidebar already uses this pattern.
decisions.audit_page_new_route: Add a dedicated /engagements/:id/audit route rather than a tab on UploadPage. Audit is a standalone verification workflow distinct from file upload. Add a nav link in Layout.tsx below Upload Data.
decisions.audit_endpoints_in_ingestion_router: Add GET /batches and GET /batches/{batch_id} to backend/app/routers/ingestion.py using raw text() SQL — consistent with the existing _update_job pattern. No new router file needed.
decisions.category_back_nav: CategoryPage already has DrilldownBreadcrumb wired. The L2 crash is a null guard issue on l3Rows. Add an explicit Back button (ArrowLeft icon, variant=outline) that calls setSelectedL1(null) and setSelectedL2(null) — more discoverable than the breadcrumb alone.

existing_tables.ingestion_batches: Tracks each CSV upload: id (TEXT PK), engagement_id, filename, row_count, new_rows, duplicate_rows, status, uploaded_at, completed_at. SQLAlchemy definition at src/models/database.py:159.
existing_tables.transactions_raw: Staging layer: id, engagement_id, batch_id, source_row_hash, pipeline_status (queued/processing/processed/review_required/failed), invoice_number, invoice_date, raw_supplier_name, base_amount, raw_data, created_at. SQLAlchemy definition at src/models/database.py:173.
existing_tables.transactions: Enriched fact table — promoted rows after supplier harmonisation and categorisation.
existing_tables.pipeline_jobs: Background job tracking: id, engagement_id, status, stage, started_at, completed_at, error_message, batch_id.

userStories.title: Fix by-supplier response extraction bug in SupplierPage and PaymentTermsPage
userStories.description: The /cube/by-supplier endpoint returns {data: SupplierRow[], total_count: N}. SupplierPage (line 75) and PaymentTermsPage (line 66) both do .then(r => r.data) and store the whole envelope as SupplierRow[], causing TypeError when .filter()/.sort()/.find()/.reduce() are called on a plain object — this is the root cause of the white page on both pages. Fix both files to extract the nested array and add staleTime:5min to all queries.

userStories.title: Add backend ingestion batch audit endpoints
userStories.description: Add two GET endpoints to backend/app/routers/ingestion.py. GET /batches returns all ingestion batches for the engagement ordered newest-first. GET /batches/{batch_id} returns batch metadata plus a pipeline_status breakdown from transactions_raw and the first 25 raw rows. Both follow the existing text()/conn.execute()/verify_engagement_ownership() pattern in the same file.
acceptanceCriteria: Edit file: backend/app/routers/ingestion.py — add GET endpoint at path /batches (full path: /api/engagements/{engagement_id}/ingest/batches). Query: SELECT id, filename, row_count, new_rows, duplicate_rows, status, uploaded_at, completed_at FROM ingestion_batches WHERE engagement_id = :eid ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC NULLS LAST. Returns list of dicts. Uses verify_engagement_ownership() and engine = Depends(_engine).

Edit file: backend/app/routers/ingestion.py — add GET endpoint at path /batches/{batch_id}. First verify the batch belongs to the engagement (SELECT engagement_id FROM ingestion_batches WHERE id = :bid; raise 404 if not found, 403 if wrong engagement). Return dict with: batch (all columns from ingestion_batches), pipeline_status_breakdown (SELECT pipeline_status, COUNT(*) as count FROM transactions_raw WHERE batch_id=:bid GROUP BY pipeline_status), sample_rows (SELECT id, invoice_number, invoice_date, raw_supplier_name, base_amount, pipeline_status FROM transactions_raw WHERE batch_id=:bid ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 25).

Run: cd backend && python -c "from app.routers.ingestion import router; routes=[r.path for r in router.routes]; print(routes)" — output should contain strings ending in '/batches' and '/batches/{batch_id}'
